intent: Extend the already-proven default-branch Issue-trigger runtime broker so the same CAP-0007 invocation adapter can execute longcycle-epistemic-trajectory/v1 specs at an exact requested branch/head from a prepared material root. The broker must only dispatch the existing CAP-0007 trajectory contract; Judgment remains CAP-0004-owned, replay remains CAP-0005-owned, Grounded Evidence remains CAP-0002-owned, and no campaign-specific workflow or duplicate semantic executor may be introduced.
rationale: CAP-0007 already owns EpistemicTrajectorySpec and its execution phases, and its extension seam explicitly routes invocation adapters through the same orchestration/trajectory contracts rather than campaign-specific workflow logic. Issues #142 and #143 prove the default-branch broker can execute exact-head v2 material-root Grounded Evidence and Reality. The remaining need is transport/invocation support for the already-existing trajectory schema so contemporaneous Judgments can run through the same PostgreSQL lifecycle without creating another workflow or reimplementing Judgment/replay semantics.
